coordinator.description: Engineering coordinator: picks GitHub issues by priority, dispatches coders into worktrees, reviews and merges PRs. Owns everything labeled owner:opencode-deepseek.

coder.description: Implements exactly one claimed GitHub issue (carrying in-progress + owner:opencode-deepseek) inside its own unique git worktree under .worktrees/opencode-deepseek/, then opens a PR labeled owner:opencode-deepseek. Never touches main or any other worktree.
